p: first ways of his father David: That is, his virtues meaning before he had committed with Bathsheba, and against Uriah.
Baalim: Did not seek help from strange Gods.
lifted up in the ways of: He gave himself wholly to serve the Lord.
teach in the cities of Judah: He knew it was in vain to profess religion, unless such were appointed who could instruct the people in the same, and had authority to put away all idolatry.
made no war against Jehoshaphat: Thus God prospers all who with a pure heart seek his glory, and keeps their enemies in fear, so that they are not able to execute their rage against them.
who willingly offered himself unto the: Meaning, who was a Nazarite.
waited on the king: That is, they were at his ordinary guard.
